props.name: as
props.description: The element or component this component should render as. Can be overwritten by `asChild`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render through the passed child element instead of the default one, merging
their props and behavior while keeping the primitive's.

props.name: clearable
props.description: When true, tapping the currently-selected rating clears the value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value of the rating when initially rendered. Use when you do not need to control the state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, all interactions are blocked.

props.name: hoverable
props.description: When true, hovering over items previews the rating (web only — Lynx native has no hover).

props.name: length
props.description: Total number of rating items rendered.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The controlled value of the rating. Can be bound with `v-model`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Layout direction of the rating items.

props.name: step
props.description: Granularity of a single item. Allows half / quarter / tenth stars.
